title: Growth and catch-up
statement: Firms in lower-income countries grow real revenue faster.
effect_unit: pp real revenue growth per +1 SD development
notes: Primary: +1 SD development → -1.41 pp real revenue growth (typical 1.8%), wild p = 0.145, 34 countries, 5,039 company-years.
Robustness: expected sign in 100% of seven samples. ESEF replication: -2.90 pp (wild p = 0.220), same direction.
Controlling for national GDP growth the coefficient is -0.31 (p = 0.639).
Profit vs growth at country level: ρ = +0.14 (n = 34).
